name: McMinnville
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in McMinnville, OR 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in McMinnville, OR: Illuminate lights and skating under the Spruce Goose, Breakfast with Santa, library gingerbread houses and more.
lede: McMinnville welcomes Santa on Third Street the day after Thanksgiving, then spends December skating beneath the Spruce Goose, driving through holiday lights and decorating gingerbread houses at the public library.
celebrates: The McMinnville Downtown Association runs Merry McMinnville, starting with Santa's Parade and Tree Lighting on Historic Third Street the day after Thanksgiving, when Santa rides at the end of the parade on a fire truck and families gather in City Park for the lighting. The North American Aerospace Museum hosts Illuminate on December weekends with Goose Lights, Santa Land, skating and a drive-through light show. The public library offers gingerbread houses, and the city's free Winter Fun program fills winter break with a Candy Cane Hunt and a Noon Year's Eve Party.
lastyear: In 2025 McMinnville's Santa Parade rolled down Third Street on the Friday after Thanksgiving, and a News-Register photo from that night shows Santa waving from atop a McMinnville fire truck. In 2026 the parade starts at 4:30 pm on November 27 with about 40 entries, from walkers to floats, gathering near the Yamhill County Courthouse before heading south to Third Street and then west, followed by the tree lighting in City Park.
facts: McMinnville is home to the Spruce Goose, the largest wooden airplane ever built. Its wingspan is 319 feet 11 inches, and it flew only once, for about 30 seconds on November 2, 1947, at Long Beach, California. The museum's founders won the bid for it in 1992, and its pieces traveled by barge up the West Coast and the Columbia and Willamette Rivers, then by truck to McMinnville in February 1993. The museum opened in 2001.
trains: McMinnville was once on the Southern Pacific Red Electric. Its Westside line ran through Yamhill County, and the Eastside and Westside lines joined north of McMinnville at St. Joseph to form the 109-mile Yamhill Loop, while the main line was extended south of McMinnville to Whiteson. Passenger trains on the loop ended in 1929. Today the closest TriMet rail is WES Commuter Rail, a weekday line serving Beaverton, Tigard, Tualatin and Wilsonville. In Portland, families can ride the Holiday Express at the Oregon Rail Heritage Center and the Washington Park and Zoo Railway.

traditions: Santa rides a fire truck at the end of the parade on Third Street, and the community tree is lit in City Park.
Holiday lights on historic aircraft, Santa Land, skating under the Spruce Goose and the Starlight Lane drive-through.
The public library hands out kits of graham crackers, frosting and candies for families to decorate.
The city's free winter break program, with a Candy Cane Hunt on Christmas Eve morning and a Noon Year's Eve Party.
McMenamins Hotel Oregon serves a December breakfast with Santa in downtown McMinnville.
The McMinnville Downtown Association runs a holiday coloring contest open to all ages, with a kids group for ages 0 to 12 and MacBucks prizes.
kidfact: The Spruce Goose in McMinnville has wings longer than a football field, 319 feet 11 inches, and it is made almost entirely of wood.
faq: When is the McMinnville Santa Parade in 2026?

The McMinnville Downtown Association's Santa's Parade and Tree Lighting is on Friday, November 27, 2026, starting at 4:30 pm on Historic Third Street. Santa rides on a fire truck at the end of the parade, and afterward the community gathers in City Park for the tree lighting, music and hot drinks.
Where can kids see the Spruce Goose at Christmas?

At the North American Aerospace Museum, which hosts Illuminate on Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays from December 4, 2026, to January 3, 2027. Families can skate beneath the Spruce Goose at Glide & Gather, see Goose Lights inside the museum, visit Santa Land and drive Starlight Lane.
Are there free Christmas events for kids in McMinnville?

Yes. The City of McMinnville's Winter Fun program says all of its winter break events are free, including a Candy Cane Hunt on December 24, a Stuffie Sleepover at the library and a Noon Year's Eve Party on December 31 at the Community Center.
Is there a Breakfast with Santa in McMinnville?
Yes. McMenamins Hotel Oregon on NE Evans Street holds Breakfast with Santa on Saturday, December 12, 2026, with seatings at 9 am and 11:30 am. Tickets are $36 per person or $265 for a table of eight.
Did trains ever run to McMinnville?
Yes. The Southern Pacific Red Electric served McMinnville, and its two lines joined north of town at St. Joseph to form the 109-mile Yamhill Loop. Passenger service on the loop ended in 1929.
